target.title: fix(cron): cancel unread local model preflight bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Cron local model-provider preflight probes Ollama `/api/tags` or OpenAI-compatible
`/models` with `fetchWithSsrFGuard`, then only inspects `response.status`.
`release()` tears down the SSRF dispatcher but does **not** cancel an unread
response body. Under undici, that leaves the TCP connection pinned until the
server finishes (or forever on a stalled/large listing body), so each scheduled
preflight can retain a socket.

## Why This Change Was Made

Cancel the unread body in `probeLocalProviderEndpoint` before `release()` when
`!response.bodyUsed`. Reachability semantics stay the same: any HTTP status still
means available; auth/model errors remain the runner's job.

## User Impact

**Before:** Status-only cron preflight against a local provider that streams or
holds the probe body could leave the request socket open after the probe
returned available.

**After:** The production preflight path cancels the unread body and the server
observes prompt socket close, without changing available/unavailable decisions.

## Evidence

- Changed: `src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.ts`,
  `src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.transport.test.ts`
- Production path: `preflightCronModelProvider` → `probeLocalProviderEndpoint` →
  `fetchWithSsrFGuard` → status-only → `body.cancel()` → `release()`
- Compatibility: probe URLs, timeout (2500ms), 5m cache, and status-only
  availability rule unchanged

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

Status-only cron local-provider preflight must cancel unread probe bodies so
undici releases the TCP socket promptly. Without cancel, a streaming `/models`
body that never ends keeps `serverObservedSocketClose: false` 250ms after the
probe returns available.

### Canonical reachability path

`preflightCronModelProvider` → `probeLocalProviderEndpoint` →
`fetchWithSsrFGuard({ auditContext: "cron-model-provider-preflight" })` →
`void response.status` → cancel unread body → `release()`

### Shared helper / provider constraint check

Uses existing `fetchWithSsrFGuard`. No new config, timeout, or probe URL surface.
Matches sibling status-only cleanup (sandbox CDP probe cancel campaign /
provider-local-service health probe cancel).

### Real environment tested

**Real Node HTTP + real `fetchWithSsrFGuard` (production `preflightCronModelProvider`):**

- Loopback `node:http` server writes headers + partial `{"models":[` and never
  ends the body
- Calls production `preflightCronModelProvider` for local
  `openai-completions` at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1`
- Observes server-side TCP `socket` `close` within 250ms of return
- macOS, Node v22.23.1

Negative control (same harness, cancel removed):

```text
{"productionFunction":"preflightCronModelProvider","probePath":"/v1/models","result":{"status":"available"},"returnedAtMs":178,"serverObservedSocketClose":false,"socketCloseAfterStartMs":null}
```

After fix:

```text
{"productionFunction":"preflightCronModelProvider","probePath":"/v1/models","result":{"status":"available"},"returnedAtMs":90,"serverObservedSocketClose":true,"socketCloseAfterStartMs":90}
```

`result.status: "available"` is unchanged in both runs; only socket release changes.

### Evidence after fix

Focused transport + unit tests:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.transport.test.ts \
  src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose

 ✓ |cron| src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.test.ts > … (4)
 ✓ |cron| src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.transport.test.ts > cancels unread local /models probe bodies and closes the request socket
 ✓ |cron| src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.transport.test.ts > cancels unread local Ollama /api/tags probe bodies and closes the request socket

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

```text
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check \
  src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.ts \
  src/cron/isolated-agent/model-preflight.runtime.transport.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
```

Premise: Undici requires every response body to be consumed or canceled; GC does
not promptly release connection resources. This probe only needs the HTTP status.

AI-assisted: Yes.
